findings.claim: A failed server-transcript fallback can leave chat reporting `isLoading: true` forever even though the graph exposes `transcriptError`.
findings.evidence: The runtime-data-sync requirement says “Load and mutation failures SHALL be exposed to the page as an error state with the runtime's message, and a failed load SHALL NOT leave the page in a permanent loading state”; this hook returns `isLoading: localIsEmpty && !isStreaming` while the new transcript fallback error is only returned as `transcriptError`, so when local messages are empty, streaming is false, and `useEntity` fails, `isLoading` remains true indefinitely.
findings.suggested_fix: Include transcript state in the loading calculation, e.g. only report loading while the local store is empty and the transcript fetch is actually loading, and force `isLoading` false when `transcriptError` is set.
